create.tagline: Share encrypted text that only the person with the link can read.
create.textPlaceholder: Paste or type the text to share...
create.passwordPlaceholder: Leave blank to skip a password
create.passwordHint: If you use one, pick a phrase of at least {{count}} characters and share it over a different channel — never alongside the link.
create.passwordTooShortError: The extra password needs at least {{count}} characters — anyone with the link can try to guess it offline, with no attempt limit.
create.genericError: Failed to create the link. Try again.
create.readyDescription: Share this link with whoever should read the message. Only someone with the complete link (including the part after "#") can decrypt the content — we never saw the original text.
create.readOnlyInstance: This instance is read-only and can't accept new messages.

burnConfirm.title: This message will be destroyed after reading
burnConfirm.description: As soon as you open this link, the content is permanently erased from the server and can't be accessed again — not even by you.

view.title: Message
view.burnedNotice: This message has been destroyed and can't be read again.
view.cancelledMessage: Reading cancelled. The message was not accessed.
view.invalidLink: This link is incomplete: the decryption key is missing (the part after "#").
view.alreadyViewed: You already opened this message in this tab. Open the original link again if you still need it.
view.notFound: This link doesn't exist, has expired, or was already read.
view.decryptError: Couldn't decrypt this message. The link may be incomplete.
view.passwordPromptDescription: Enter the password agreed with whoever sent you the link.
